brandbook.motif: Tres trazos apilados derivados de las líneas de un registro de existencias. La marca petróleo de la fila activa prolonga esta lógica de registro y vincula el producto con su editor; no convertir el motivo en patrón decorativo.

pages.title: Brand guidelines
pages.summary: Herramienta interna de inventario para un taller ficticio: nombres, existencias y acciones claras, con registros persistidos y confirmaciones fiables. No es una marca comercial abierta al público.

examples.text: Preserve the supplied name, petrol palette, IBM Plex Sans and three-line register motif.

examples.text: Rules are in English; interface specimens remain in Spanish. Fictional seed products and prices are demonstration content.

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Describe Almacén Nube as an internal inventory tool, not a shop or public marketplace. Lead with the task and keep supporting copy to one short sentence.

examples.text: Consulta productos, comprueba existencias y actualiza el registro.
examples.title: Inventario del taller

examples.text: Use Dashboard and Productos as navigation labels. Do not introduce Tienda, Pedidos or payment language.
examples.title: Scope language

pages.title: Project Intent
pages.summary: Express the supplied project goal rather than inventing a corporate mission: make saved inventory easy to read and product changes explicit. Avoid absolute reliability claims.

examples.text: Keep the product name visible from selection through editing, conflict and confirmation.
examples.title: Working intent

examples.text: Consulta las existencias guardadas antes de actualizar un producto.
examples.title: Operational copy

pages.title: Working Principles
pages.summary: Translate project priorities into visible behavior: readable records, explicit actions and honest status. Treat these as design principles, not claims about a real company's values.

examples.text: Show Nombre, Categoría, Stock and Precio together; never hide price or actions behind an unexplained icon.
examples.title: Clarity

examples.text: Use Resultado sin confirmar when a response is lost. Reserve Producto actualizado for a confirmed save.
examples.title: Honest status

examples.text: Keep the draft visible after validation errors and retain the product name during recovery.
examples.title: Continuity

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write direct, calm Spanish. Start actions with verbs, name the affected product and distinguish pending work from confirmed results. Avoid celebration, blame and vague technical errors.

examples.text: Nuevo producto · Editar · Eliminar · Reintentar
examples.title: Action

examples.text: Introduce un stock entero igual o mayor que cero.
examples.title: Validation

examples.text: Resultado sin confirmar. Recupera el resultado antes de volver a enviar cambios.
examples.title: Uncertain result

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the logo section with the symbol and name as separate elements. The three stacked strokes refer to inventory lines; do not turn them into a cloud illustration.

examples.text: Three register lines beside a clear typographic name.
examples.title: Almacén Nube

examples.text: Place the supported symbol above a short heading on petrol. Leave the remainder of the page quiet.
examples.title: Divider composition

pages.title: Logo Overview
pages.summary: Use one canonical symbol: three equal horizontal strokes with regular spacing. Pair it with live IBM Plex Sans typography so the name stays sharp, editable and accessible.

examples.text: On the 160-unit canvas, strokes are 96 × 16 units at x32 and y40, y72, y104, with 4-unit corner radii.
examples.title: Canonical geometry

examples.text: Almacén Nube retains its accent, capitalization and natural letter spacing. Never embed the name inside the symbol SVG.
examples.title: Name treatment

pages.title: Primary Logo
pages.summary: Place the symbol left of Almacén Nube in IBM Plex Sans 600. Align the visible strokes optically with the lettering; use Ink for the name and Petrol Signal for the symbol.

examples.text: Use a 40 px symbol canvas, a 12 px gap and a 20 px name on the white desktop navigation surface.
examples.title: Navigation lockup

examples.text: At phone width, use a 32 px symbol canvas with an 18 px name. Preserve the full Almacén Nube spelling.
examples.title: Compact lockup

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Use one stroke thickness as the minimum clear space around the visible symbol and complete lockup. Increase breathing room in covers and signs; never fill the space with controls.

examples.text: One unit of clear space equals 16 units in the master drawing. The canonical canvas already provides at least this margin.
examples.title: Symbol spacing

examples.text: Keep Dashboard and Productos below the lockup, outside its clear space, rather than attaching them to the name.
examples.title: Navigation spacing

pages.title: Logo Color Combinations
pages.summary: Keep the symbol geometry and petrol fill unchanged. On dark or petrol backgrounds, use a white support surface; set the separate name in white.

examples.text: White surface, #125563 symbol and #172F35 Almacén Nube lettering.
examples.title: Light application

examples.text: Ink background, white symbol support and white lettering. Do not place the petrol strokes directly on Ink.
examples.title: Dark application

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the standalone mark only where the surrounding context identifies Almacén Nube. Preserve all three strokes and their internal spacing at every size.

examples.text: Center the canonical mark on a white square. Retain the full 160-unit canvas rather than cropping tightly to the strokes.
examples.title: Application icon

examples.text: Use the symbol without lettering at 16–32 px. Keep the bars crisp; do not add outlines, shadows or small interior details.
examples.title: Small-size rule

pages.title: Logo Misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, outline or decorate the mark. Never replace the exact name with an abbreviation or use the three strokes as an unlabeled navigation control.

examples.text: Correct: Almacén Nube. Incorrect: Almacen Nube, ALMACÉN-NUBE or AN inside a box.
examples.title: Name integrity

examples.text: Do not turn the strokes into a cloud, barcode, hamburger button or repeated wallpaper.
examples.title: Symbol integrity

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use IBM Plex Sans throughout the identity. Introduce the section with a Spanish operational headline and a short supporting line, not a font catalog.

examples.text: Consulta productos y comprueba las existencias guardadas.
examples.title: Inventario del taller

examples.text: Set the specimen left aligned. Use one strong heading and regular body text with no decorative letter spacing.
examples.title: Section composition

pages.title: Typography Overview
pages.summary: Build recognition through one family, clear weight changes and stable number alignment. Keep Spanish accents intact and avoid condensed, italic or all-capital interface labels.

examples.text: Busca por nombre o filtra por categoría.
examples.title: Productos

examples.text: Use tabular figures for Stock and Precio. Align numeric columns right and names left.
examples.title: Numeric treatment

pages.title: Primary Typeface
pages.summary: IBM Plex Sans is the planned heading and body family. Supplied distributable files cover 400, 500, 600 and 700; use local font assets. Any temporary system fallback is not the brand typeface.

examples.text: Introduce el nombre, la categoría, el stock y el precio.

pages.title: Weights & Styles
pages.summary: Use 400 for body text, 500 for actions and 600 for UI headings and the name. Reserve the supplied 700 rendering weight for manual headings; do not apply it to every interface label.

examples.text: Revisa los campos antes de guardar.
examples.title: Guardar cambios

examples.text: Productos: 600. Guardar cambios: 500. Field help: 400. Keep upright styles and natural spacing throughout.
examples.title: Weight mapping

pages.title: Supporting Type
pages.summary: Support headings with IBM Plex Sans 400, not a second decorative family. Use Deep Petrol for secondary text and keep essential instructions at readable body size.

examples.text: Los productos y precios iniciales son demostrativos.
examples.title: Datos iniciales ficticios

examples.text: Use 16 px for field help and important status. Reserve 12–14 px for compact metadata; never use border gray for text.
examples.title: Small text

pages.title: Type Hierarchy
pages.summary: Set UI titles at 28–32 px/600, body and fields at 16 px/400, and navigation and buttons at 14 px or larger. Keep secondary text at least 12 px.

examples.text: Productos: 6 · Unidades: 81 · Sin existencias: 1 · Valor del stock: 310,40 €
examples.title: Inventario del taller

examples.text: Title first, primary action second, metrics or filters next. Use size and spacing before introducing another weight.
examples.title: Reading order

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use one work column and a 4/8/12/16/24/32 px spacing scale. Align title, filters and register edges. Desktop navigation is 208 px wide and extends to the document bottom.

examples.text: Busca un producto y selecciona Editar para actualizarlo.
examples.title: Productos

examples.text: Move navigation above the content. Keep the full table with wrapping names and text actions; limit overlay forms to 560 px.
examples.title: 768 px study

examples.text: Use a 48 px header, visible 44 px navigation and two 44 px filter rows. Show the start of the list without a floating dock.
examples.title: 390 px study

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Let pale surfaces carry the work and petrol identify action or selection. Use dark text for information; color must never be the only signal of status.

examples.text: Clear Workspace #F4F7F7 behind Paper #FFFFFF surfaces, with Ink #172F35 text.
examples.title: Everyday pairing

examples.text: Nuevo producto uses white text on Petrol Signal #125563. Selected navigation also needs a visible shape or marker.
examples.title: Action pairing

pages.title: Color Roles
pages.summary: Preserve the five supplied palette values. Deep Petrol is the secondary-text color; #70878D is an additional control-boundary token, not muted body text.

examples.text: Clear Workspace #F4F7F7: page. Paper #FFFFFF: table and editor. Ink #172F35: primary reading.
examples.title: Surface roles

examples.text: Petrol Signal #125563: actions and selected rows. Deep Petrol #103D47: supporting text and darker action emphasis.
examples.title: Signal roles

examples.text: Use #70878D for control edges, targeting at least 3:1 contrast. Do not fade essential borders into the background.
examples.title: Boundary role

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Keep brand colors solid in logos, text and controls. A pale petrol overlay may identify a selected row, but its solid marker and text must remain legible without the tint.

examples.text: Martillo de carpintero may sit on a 6% petrol overlay over white, with a solid #125563 edge and Ink text.
examples.title: Selected record

examples.text: Use pale neutral skeletons and Cargando productos… rather than tinted zeros that resemble confirmed data.
examples.title: Loading treatment

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Extend the register motif through straight rules, aligned rows and the active-row marker. Do not multiply the logo into a pattern or add decorative metric cards.

examples.text: Separate Productos, Unidades, Sin existencias and Valor del stock with quiet rules inside one continuous band.
examples.title: Continuous metrics

examples.text: Retain the petrol row marker while the editor enters 12 px over 160 ms. With reduced motion, show its final position immediately.
examples.title: Editing connection

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple, consistent line icons alongside Spanish text. Keep Editar and Eliminar visible as words; status icons must reinforce a message, not replace it.

examples.text: Visible: Editar. Accessible name: Editar Martillo de carpintero. Keep the interaction target at least 44 px.
examples.title: Named actions

examples.text: Pair an alert icon with Resultado sin confirmar and a recovery action. Never rely on amber alone.
examples.title: Status pairing

pages.title: Image Policy
pages.summary: Use no photography, illustrations or video in the app. Product identity comes from names, categories and numbers. Documentation may show interface studies without adding image slots to products.

examples.text: Martillo de carpintero · Herramientas · 8 unidades · 14,50 €. No thumbnail or decorative tool photograph.
examples.title: Product presentation

examples.text: Start with Inventario del taller and the metrics band, not a workshop photograph or promotional banner.
examples.title: Dashboard treatment

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build the visual reference board from typography, ruled records, pale surfaces and petrol marks. Favor legible density over decorative dashboards or atmospheric imagery.

examples.text: White register sheet, dark readable labels, aligned quantities and three stacked petrol strokes.
examples.title: Material references

examples.text: Prefer the tabular register. Avoid a permanent master-detail split and isolated metric cards that reduce working space.
examples.title: Composition choice
